summary: Iteration 32 — validated ShopPHP robustness fix (accepts bare xmlc code OR full URL in any of api_key/api_secret/supplier_id, auto-sorted by c=) and dashboard money-masking additions (total_bank_balance, total_receivables, total_payables, monthly_sales, value, not_due, overdue, gelir, gider). Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed against the live tenant (comp_nexus_main_01) — GET /api/integrations/ecommerce → shopphp status=connected; POST test-connection → success with 'sipariş' + 'ürün' in message; POST sync-now?days=30 → success live=true; GET /api/orders → shopphp orders with contact_id; GET /api/marketplace/products?channel=shopphp → live=true count≥20 (29 rows). Robustness: PUT with FULL URLs in correct slots → success; PUT with api_key/api_secret URLs SWAPPED → STILL success (auto-sorted by c= type); PUT api_key='' → status=error with 'Sipariş XML' in message; then restored. Dashboard masking: with warehouse.view_prices=false, /api/dashboard/overview and /api/dashboard/stats return X-Prices-Masked=1 and total_bank_balance / total_receivables / total_payables / monthly_sales all zeroed for depo@nexus.com; restored view_prices=true. Frontend (admin): /ecommerce ShopPHP card shows 'Bağlantı Aktif'; test-btn-shopphp toast: "ShopPHP XML bağlantısı başarılı: sipariş XML'inde 2 sipariş, ürün XML: 29 ürün/varyasyon."; sync-btn-shopphp toast: 'ShopPHP: 2 sipariş okundu → 0 yeni, 2 güncellendi.'; config-btn-shopphp modal shows labels containing 'kod veya tam adres' and 'RSS değil' as required; İptal closes without saving. /orders → 'Ürünler & Fiyat' tab → mp-channel-select=shopphp → 29 mp-row-* testids rendered (≥20).
critical_code_review_comments: marketplace_providers.shopphp_resolve stores raw store_url without normalization when user leaves it blank; derivation from URL netloc works, but if user typed store_url without scheme it prefixes https:// blindly — acceptable but could confuse http-only stores.

rbac.MONEY_KEYS is now quite broad (includes generic keys like 'value', 'week', 'today', 'month_total', 'yearly', 'average', 'limit', 'cash', 'bank', 'pos', 'kdv'). Risk of over-masking non-money fields on other endpoints; consider scoping masking per response schema or adding an allow-list per-route.

shopphp_products_xml raises HTTPException(400) inside a route body that returns {status:success,...} otherwise — good UX, but if test-connection is expected to always 200 with status field, ensure 400s here are caught to status=error (currently server.py wraps them; verified in this iteration).
test_credentials: admin@nexus.com/admin123, depo@nexus.com/depo123 — both worked without hash reset this iteration. Login endpoint returns 'token' key (not 'access_token').
seed_data_creation: None persistent. ShopPHP integration cfg was PUT with URLs in wrong slots then restored to (api_key=URL siparisler, api_secret=URL shopphp, supplier_id=URL alter). Warehouse role.view_prices toggled false then restored to true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live ShopPHP tenant returns 2 orders / 29 products at time of test. Store host: www.willhome.com.tr. XML codes: siparisler=25d7e750b1, shopphp=4612835257, alter=a26078d69d. Marketplace panel uses native <select> for mp-channel-select — use page.select_option not click. Login response uses key 'token', not 'access_token'.
rca_of_issue: Original user bug 'shopphp bağlandı gibi ama bilgi çekemedi' was caused by user pasting full URLs into any of the 3 slots in arbitrary order; old code expected bare xmlc codes in fixed slots (api_key=orders, api_secret=products, supplier_id=stock). Fix in marketplace_providers.shopphp_resolve now parses each field with urlparse, extracts xmlc query param, and buckets it by the c= query param into orders/products/stock; store_url is derived from the URL host if not provided. Test proves 'swapped' PUT still works. Dashboard masking gap from iteration_31 (dashboard money keys not in MONEY_KEYS) is now closed — the widened MONEY_KEYS set includes total_bank_balance/total_receivables/total_payables/monthly_sales and the not_due/overdue/gelir/gider aggregates verified zeroed with X-Prices-Masked header.
